sites.name: Ly Son Island (Cu Lao Re)
sites.event: Known as the 'Garlic Kingdom', a place preserving historical evidence of sovereignty over Hoang Sa (Hoang Sa Soldier Feast and Commemoration Ceremony).

place.commune: Ly Son Island District (including An Vinh, An Hai, An Binh Communes)

sites.name: Son My Vestige Area (My Lai Massacre)
sites.event: The site marking the horrific massacre on March 16, 1968, caused by the US military, which claimed the lives of 504 innocent civilians.

sites.name: Thien An Pagoda (Tomb of Huynh Thuc Khang)
sites.event: An ancient pagoda located on the peak of Thien An Mountain ('Niem Ha An Trien' - the top scenic spot of Quang Ngai), the resting place of the patriotic scholar Huynh Thuc Khang.

sites.name: Sa Huynh Salt Field
sites.event: The cradle of Sa Huynh Culture (one of the 3 ancient cultures of Vietnam) and one of the largest and oldest salt basins in Central Vietnam.

sites.name: Ba To Uprising Relic Area
sites.event: The site of the Ba To Uprising (March 11, 1945), marking the birth of the Ba To Guerrilla Team - the predecessor of the Military Region 5 armed forces.

sites.name: Minh Long White Waterfall
sites.event: A majestic waterfall over 40m high located in the deep forest, likened to the hair of a fairy in the vast jungle.

sites.name: Prime Minister Pham Van Dong Memorial Site
sites.event: The birthplace, childhood home, and place preserving memorabilia of the revolutionary life of the late Prime Minister Pham Van Dong.

sites.name: My Khe Beach
sites.event: The most beautiful and famous beach in Quang Ngai, once chosen by the US military as a recreation area during the war.

sites.name: Dang Thuy Tram Clinic Relic
sites.event: The workplace and place of sacrifice of the female doctor and Hero of the People's Armed Forces Dang Thuy Tram, author of the deeply moving 'Dang Thuy Tram's Diary'.

sites.name: Ganh Yen
sites.event: A pristine natural scenic spot with unique layered volcanic sedimentary rock formations, where swiftlets often come to nest.

sites.name: Chau Sa Ancient Citadel
sites.event: The only earthen citadel of the Champa Kingdom still existing in Vietnam, once the administrative center of Amaravati.

sites.name: Ba Lang An Cape
sites.event: A cape featuring an ancient lighthouse and a unique underwater volcanic crater terrain, near the Dam Toai Tunnels relic.
